question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The examination or observation of one's own mental and emotional processes
solution: The correct answer is '**Introspection**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Introspection**'. • It means 'the process of thinking deeply and carefully to examine your own ideas, feelings, etc.' (गहराई से सोचना तथा अपने विचारों, भावनाओं आदि का परीक्षण करना; आत्म-मंथन; आत्म-विश्लेषण) • *Example: After a little bit of **introspection** I was able to get to the bottom of the problem.* **​​Correct Answer:__** *Introspection.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Assessment**: the action of assessing someone or something. (सोचा-समझा अभिमत, मूल्‍यांकन, राय) • **Inspection**: careful examination or scrutiny. (जाँच, निरीक्षण) • **Valuation**: a professional judgment about how much money something is worth. (किसी वस्‍तु का मूल्‍य-निर्धारण) 3a:Tb8a, The correct answer is '**BACD**'.
